caseNameFull: S. A. McHenry v. Bankers Trust Company
summary: Error to the Court of Civil Appeals, First Supreme Judicial District, of the State of Texas.
attorneys: Mr. Don A. Bliss for plaintiffs in error. Mr. B. F. Louis and Mr. D. W. Glasscock, for defendants in error, submitted.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction upon the authority of the Act of September 6, 1916, c. 448, 39 Stat. 726.
